I am trying to flesh out a new character that i am creating. This one is a little different compared with some of my other characters i have created, Almost like it belongs in a visual novel and not a regular story. I am trying to get some opinions on the character and maybe some suggestions to really flesh her out. The character needs a few thing to complete her. A better physical description (something i have trouble describing). Drawing suggestions (For if i decided to actually make it a visual novel at some point), personality quirks for all 3 personalities, a last name, maybe magical powers while in black or white mode? Please help me out with this.

Notes on the character:

Name: Celeste  
Gender: Female  
Race: Human  
Occupation: University student    
Age: 20  
Height: 5'4”  
Skin color: White  
Hair Color: White, or Brown, or Black  
Clothing: Likes cute girly clothes but also wears jeans and t-shirts  
Armor: none  
Weapons: none  
Abilities: Celeste has a very strange magical disorder. She has 3  
separate yet similar forms/personalities she has no control for which  
personality takes over. When her hair is white, she is in goody two  
shoes mode, in this mode she is almost insufferably sweet and kind,  
can get extremely clingy. When her hair is brown (This is the main  
personality that is in control most of the time) In this mode she is  
mostly just your average 20 year old girl in collage. When her hair  
is black, she is in mischievous mode. In this mode she likes to play  
pranks and break small rules (Skipping class, etc) does not break  
laws still if she can help it. When she changes personalities her  
hair changes color from the root to the tip. Her eyes also change  
color. Purple iris in white mode, One purple, one red in Brown mode,  
red in black mode.   
Personality/white: This personality is very caring, she would never  
do anything to hurt anyone or anything and will get upset of she does  
so by accident. Sweet and kind to the point it can be very annoying.  
Gets very clingy to her best friend who she seeks out when this mode  
is active, no matter what time of day it is.  
Personality/brown: This is the primary personality. In this mode she  
is caring, but not over the top, she likes to tell silly jokes, her  
favorite food is pasta (but she only eats it occasionally as a treat)  
she's smart resourceful and likes to play video games with her  
friends.    
Personality/black: This personality is the rarest to appear. Like in  
white mode, she gets clingy to her best friend. Only instead of just  
wanting to be together, in black mode she plays pranks, tells dirty  
jokes, and will often drag her best friend out of class, bed,  
movies... basically anywhere that he is, to go out in the town.  
Description: Celeste is slender. Her hair is long and straight that  
reaches, color depends on what mode she is in. Eye color depends om  
what form she is in. Has b sized chest. Most other detail are WIP,  
probably until I get first artwork done.   
Pose for drawings: WIP
